name: 3D Gaussian Splatting with Feature Splatting
aliases: High Fidelity Point Cloud Rendering via Feature Splatting
PFGS (Point Cloud Gaussian Splatting with Feature Splatting)
definition: A rendering method that extends 3D Gaussian Splatting to handle semantic features alongside color, enabling high-fidelity point cloud rendering by splatting both color and semantic feature tensors through the rasterization pipeline.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting with Feature Splatting extends standard rendering to preserve semantic information by accumulating multi-channel feature tensors alongside RGB color during rasterization.
